entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I'd like to start a return for an order. My order number is VF88675.
I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up order VF88675... Okay, I see the Aero Race Jersey. Can I ask, what specifically is the issue with the item?
It's just the wrong size for me. I ordered a medium, but it's way too tight across the chest. I was hoping to exchange it or just return it.
I understand. Getting the right fit is crucial for performance. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see it was delivered 65 days ago.
That sounds about right. I know it's been a while, I just haven't had a chance to try it on until recently.

No problem at all. According to our policy, your jersey is still well within the 90-day return window. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email on file right now. You should see it in the next few minutes.

Oh, that's great. Thanks. Since I have to go through the trouble of repackaging and sending this one back, and then placing a new order, would it be possible to get a small discount code for the new jersey?

I understand the request. While our system doesn't allow me to generate discount codes for a sizing exchange, the good news is that you will receive a full refund for the original item once we receive it. You can then apply that directly to purchasing the correct size.
Okay, that's fair. A full refund works for me. I appreciate you making the return so simple.
You're very welcome. Once you drop the package off with the carrier, you can expect the refund to process within 5-7 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Alex.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
